prose: The Wall Street Journal reports PHP has disclosed a critical memory-management vulnerability dubbed PHP2Shell that affects up to 70% of websites, discovered using GPT-5.6 Sol in August. The article could not be fetched, so this summary is limited to the headline; sibling stories today cover the Wiz writeup and Cloudflare's mitigations.
highlights: PHP discloses critical memory-management bug dubbed PHP2Shell
Discovered using GPT-5.6 Sol in August
Source: Robert McMillan, WSJ, via Techmeme
